name: Goblin Roulette
author: Monstrox
bootlegger: I Claim Goblin! Each non-Demon player is either Goblin, Alcheist-Goblin or thinks they are one of those!
All Outsiders are the Hermit, Alchemists receive true info.
The Vortox ability is changed, from "Each day, if no one is executed, Evil wins" to "Each day, if an Alchemist-Goblin or Goblin is not executed, Evil wins." All other Demons also have this ability.
This is just a funny script, mainly meant for a group to practice reading eachother socially and meta-ing the ST.
